objective: Reconcile owner-approved dark transparent Genesis visual panels on six grouped Home/Cluster/Organization cards, preserving business rules and ad lifecycle.
productionBaselineEvidence: Current production main SHA 551e54602addd6f7bbe7bcdddd1589d35424c964; Genesis DEV base PR #1021 head 7c497e3dd4f136259ff88ea7dcfc0540b9d4f158. App owner provided Android screenshots, but production live runtime and OTA not tested. DEV only.
chosenApproach: Create a single shared Genesis preview glass color authority and noninteractive static local background element, with conditional style branches for Today, Drawer, PTT native/web, contribution, scope profile, fund and ranking. Maintain all existing backend and native paths.
selectionRationale: Opaque light cards currently block the existing cosmic background, breaking the season-wide aesthetic; localized conditional color updates preserve production and avoid a dangerous global theme override.
alternativeApproaches: Global theme override rejected due to legibility regression risk for forms and financial controls.
Remote animated gallery rejected due to weak-network and AdMob/navigation performance concerns.
Recoloring Google-native ad creative rejected because provider ads and reporting must remain intact.

lockedFeatureChanges.reason: Preview-only Genesis card surfaces and locally bundled static image backdrop, with no production runtime modification.
preservedBehaviors: Current Home tab, responsive navigation, offline caches, Wall media, native ads, and no extra network loads remain intact.

lockedFeatureChanges.reason: Reconcile BUKLOD PTT navigation card color and border with Genesis glass while preserving live connection and route actions.
preservedBehaviors: PTT connection status subscriptions and existing push-to-talk route, signaling and real-time authorization are unchanged.

lockedFeatureChanges.reason: Make QMP and contribution explanatory panels readable on Genesis dark surfaces without changing server-awarded amounts or ad placement.
preservedBehaviors: Backend QMP/revenue estimate, scope fund ledger, rankings, native AdMob creative, impression and click surfaces remain untouched.

preserveBehaviors: Season 1 production styling remains unchanged because isGenesisPreviewBuild is explicit staging-only.
